title: Alumini Connect
description: Alumni Connect is a full-stack web application built using the MERN stack designed to bridge the gap between alumni and current students of an institution. The platform enables seamless networking, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the college community.

title: AgentArena
description: AgentArena is a next-generation Multi-AI Comparison Platform where users can pit two AI models against each other and let an independent Judge AI determine the winner.

title: Vastra Elite
description: Vastra Elite is a modern and stylish fashion e-commerce web application designed to provide users with a seamless online shopping experience. The platform allows customers to explore fashion collections, browse products, view detailed product information, add items to their cart, and enjoy a smooth and responsive shopping experience.
